project_type: Next.js 15 Full-Stack App (App Router) - Engineering Document Intelligence Platform for Indian Railways
build_system: npm with Next.js 15 (App Router), Biome for linting, Turbopack for dev
test_framework: Vitest for unit/integration, React Testing Library for components
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run lint' (Biome) to check for lint errors. 2. Run 'npm run build' to verify production build. 3. Run 'npm run dev' to verify dev server starts. 4. Check graphify.json for task completion status.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/LDO_rahul. 2. npm install. 3. npm run dev (starts on port 3000).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full npm/package access. Node.js v22 available. No PostgreSQL/Redis running yet - use mock data initially. Files stored on network drive (simulated locally at ./storage/). Biome for linting (not ESLint).
contribution_requirements: Use Biome for linting. Update graphify task graph after each task completion. Follow design.md UI design system strictly (orange #d38738 primary accent, dense Vercel-style, OKLCH tokens, 46px header, 232px sidebar, 5 KPI cards per row). Start with mock data but structure API hooks for PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM. File deduplication via metadata + 3-point 64kb hash.
key_patterns: tRPC routers for API, Drizzle ORM schemas ready for PostgreSQL, shadcn/ui components, Zustand for state, TanStack Query for data fetching, React Hook Form + Zod for forms, BullMQ for background jobs, content-addressed file storage (SHA-256), OKLCH color system from design.md
directory_structure: Greenfield project - structure to be created: src/app/ (Next.js App Router pages), src/components/ (UI components), src/lib/ (utilities, db, auth, storage), src/server/ (tRPC routers, services), src/hooks/ (React hooks), src/stores/ (Zustand), public/ (static assets), storage/ (file storage simulation)
